Fire at the GRIDCo Mallam substation has disrupted power in parts of Accra including Lapaz, Awoshie and Anyaa.

Firefighters extinguished the blaze before it could spread to other critical equipment.

Power has been restored to some areas while engineers work to replace the burnt transformer.
